title: Cowboy Butter Chicken Orzo
creator: Mamas Down South Kitchen
cookTime: Brown chicken, toast orzo a few minutes, then simmer covered 12-15 minutes
ingredients: Seasonings for the chicken: cowboy butter seasoning, paprika, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder (amounts not stated)
2 tablespoons oil, for cooking the chicken
1/2 teaspoon each paprika, chili powder, onion powder, and garlic powder
1/2 cup parmesan, plus more for topping
Optional garnish: dried chives or parsley
instructions: Step 1: Season the chicken with the chicken seasonings.
Step 2: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until browned; it will finish cooking with the orzo, so you mainly want color on it.
Step 3: Add the butter and let it melt, then add the orzo and toast for a few minutes while stirring.
Step 4: Add the broth, Dijon mustard, cowboy butter seasoning, all-purpose seasoning, paprika, chili powder, onion powder, garlic powder, pepper, and lemon juice. Stir to combine.
Step 5: Over medium heat, bring to a simmer, then cover and cook 12-15 minutes until the orzo is done, stirring a couple of times to prevent sticking.
Step 6: Once the orzo is cooked, stir in the cream and parmesan until the cheese melts.
Step 7: Top with extra parmesan and dried chives or parsley, and serve.
notes: From a Mamas Down South Kitchen Facebook reel; recipe from the creator's reply under the pinned 'Author' comment.
